decisions.why: Accent 1000, 800, 1400 and Liberator Rugged 7 are speech-generating devices.
Eye gaze bundles and eyegaze software are AAC access methods.
Switches, switch mounting and Glassouse devices are AAC access hardware.
Headpointing, switch interfaces, joysticks and trackballs are alternative access for AAC users.
Communication, cause-and-effect, switch skills and emulation titles are AAC software.
AbleNet communicators, GoTalk and low-tech comm aids are non-powered AAC.
Batteries, carry cases, keyguards and waterproof covers are accessories to the speech-generating device range.
